details.description: Claude v2 (Amazon Bedrock model ID anthropic.claude-v2:1) is Claude 2.1, an update to Claude 2.0 that Anthropic released in November 2023 with a 200K-token context window, a beta tool-use (function calling) feature, and system prompt support. Anthropic reports Claude 2.1 cut incorrect answers on hard factual questions by 30% and reduced mistaken claims of document support by 3-4x compared to Claude 2.0. Anthropic retired Claude 2.0 and 2.1 from its own Claude API on July 21, 2025, recommending migration to Claude Opus 4.8; Amazon Bedrock, which sets its own schedule, no longer lists Claude v2 among its currently supported models.
advantages: 200,000-token context window, twice Claude 2.0's, letting it process roughly 150,000 words or 500+ pages of documents, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
Beta tool use (function calling) and system prompt support, introduced with this version, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
50% fewer hallucinated false statements in open-ended conversation and document Q&A than Claude 2.0, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
30% fewer incorrect answers on hard factual questions, and a 3-4x lower rate of mistakenly concluding a document supports a claim, versus Claude 2.0, per Anthropic's Claude 2.1 model card appendix.
disadvantages: Anthropic retired Claude 2.0 and 2.1 from the Claude API on July 21, 2025, recommending Claude Opus 4.8 as a replacement.
Text only: no image input, unlike later Claude models.
8,191-token max output, small next to current Claude models.
use_cases: Summarizing and answering questions on very long documents, up to roughly 150,000 words, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
Forecasting trends, comparing multiple documents, drafting business plans, and analyzing complex contracts, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
Tool use (function calling) for workflow orchestration, in beta at launch, per AWS's Bedrock announcement.
General open-ended conversation, writing, editing, and coding, per Anthropic's Claude 2 model card.

notes: The target's URIs are all 'anthropic.claude-v2:1', which maps specifically to Claude 2.1, not Claude 2.0. Catalog lists max_input_tokens as 100,000, but AWS's own Bedrock announcement and Anthropic's Claude 2.1 model card appendix both state a 200,000-token context window for this version; kept the catalog's value per instructions. The standard benchmark scores (MMLU, GSM8K, etc.) in Anthropic's Claude 2 model card were measured for Claude 2.0 and not re-run for 2.1 -- the appendix says 'in most other respects, Claude 2.1 remains similar to Claude 2.0' without republishing those numbers -- so evaluations is left empty rather than attributing Claude 2.0's scores to 2.1; the appendix's own 2.1-specific results are relative reductions, not 0-100 accuracy scores, so they appear in advantages instead. Catalog lists no deprecation_date for this target; Anthropic itself retired Claude 2.0/2.1 from its own Claude API on July 21, 2025, and as of today (2026-09-24) Claude v2 no longer appears in Amazon Bedrock's current 'Models at a glance' listing, suggesting Bedrock access has also ended, though we found no Bedrock-specific EOL date or announcement to cite.
